headline: With Switch 2, iPhone, and laptop tricks, the Sharge Disk Pro 2 is finally a worthy EDC
summary: This new portable SSD finally impresses the reviewer. It functions as a versatile 4K HDMI dock. The Disk Pro 2 Ultra is deemed a worthy everyday carry.

headline: Apple’s new AirTags are back down to their best price
summary: Apple AirTag four-packs are currently on sale for $89. This deal matches the product's all-time low price. Find the offer at Amazon and Target retailers.

headline: Google Earth’s AI deepfake tool only lasted one day
summary: Google launched an AI tool letting users edit satellite images. The feature allowed for AI deepfakes of real-world locations. Google quickly shut down the tool after just one day online.

headline: The NHTSA is investigating 1.2 million Tesla vehicles over suspension failure reports
summary: NHTSA is investigating nearly 1.2 million Tesla vehicles. The probe follows reports of suspension failure causing directional control loss. Models 3 (2018-2020) and Y (2021-2023) are included.

headline: Everything Coming to Netflix in August 2026
summary: Netflix is set to release a new slate of content in August 2026. Expect titles like Chucky, Fast and Furious, and a Ricky Gervais cartoon. The lineup aims to close out the summer.

headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Leak on Social Media Reportedly Seen by Millions Before Sony Took It Down
summary: A high-quality bootleg of 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' leaked online. Millions reportedly viewed the content across social media platforms like X/Twitter. Sony quickly acted to remove the widespread leak.

headline: Everything Coming to Disney+ in August
summary: Disney+ is adding a strong lineup of content for August. The additions include popular franchises like Star Wars and X-Men. Viewers can also find Pokémon and some League of Legends content.

headline: Amazon Is Having a Lord of the Rings T-Shirt Sale This Weekend
summary: Amazon is hosting a special sale on Lord of the Rings T-shirts. The promotional event is scheduled for this weekend only. Fans can grab discounted apparel from the iconic franchise.

headline: Fifa scraps World Cup investment plan after outcry
summary: FIFA has abandoned its controversial World Cup investment plan. Gianni Infantino stated the project 'created divisions'. The proposed sale of stakes in major competitions will not proceed.

headline: Labour's Bev Craig elected Greater Manchester mayor, succeeding Andy Burnham
summary: Labour's Bev Craig has been elected Greater Manchester mayor. She succeeds Andy Burnham in the prominent regional role. Craig secured nearly double the votes of her Reform UK opponent.

headline: Israeli West Bank settler tells BBC attacks on Palestinians are justified as revenge
summary: An Israeli West Bank settler justified attacks on Palestinians as revenge to the BBC. Settler violence against Palestinians is reportedly on the rise. This increase coincides with the expansion of settlements and outposts.

headline: Sir John Curtice: The "Burnham bounce" is real but it's not massive
summary: Sir John Curtice confirms a 'Burnham bounce' in poll ratings. The governing party's standing has seen improvement. However, their lead over Reform remains narrow.
